regionDesign.point_model: Original v2 clean-validation-selected seed42 model separately in each spatial fold
regionDesign.parameter_source: Fixed medium feature radius and a small display-support minimum; no label-based tuning
regionDesign.scope: Connected components of sampled original held-out predicted-positive cores. Buffered interiors have gaps; not full-cloud object segmentation.
regionDesign.scores: Mean model output scores are not calibrated probabilities of construction completion
regionDesign.temporal_scope: Per-pair earlier/later acquisition indices; no verified component identity association across pairs
regionDesign.construction_claim: Candidate added/removed geometry only. No installed-component labels, material quantities, or project completion percentages.

notice: Saved sampled held-out predictions. No live inference, training or full-cloud rendering.
